notes.text: Turn 3 flip shows The Sentry Drone twice in one reveal on floor 1, as in playtests 14 and 15. Is a floor deck meant to hold several copies of one stairwell? Entering Puzzle Room instead since Red cannot reach Oomph 8 from this hand.

Gray's Good Stuff reveal showed Coil Of Cable twice in one three-card reveal (Cutting Torch, Coil, Coil). Rulebook does not say whether a Stuff pool holds copies of one card. Question for the designer.

Red's reward pool shows Second Wind now, one turn after I took Second Wind from it (which sits in Red's deck), and Fast Follow again after I took one. Same question as playtest 15 note 2: does a reward pool hold copies of a card?

Turn 7 flip: three Sentry Drones, the only rooms left. Same duplicate question as the earlier notes. Entering one; Gray's I Know Kung Fu (Oomph 5) plus Red's Pry Bar (Oomph 3) makes Oomph 8 for one paid card.

Gray's card reward reveal shows Pivot twice in one three-card reveal (Synergy Link, Pivot, Pivot). So a reward pool does hold copies of one card, at least here. Rulebook silent. Question for the designer: is that intended?

Floor 2's first reveal shows Gears & Glitch twice (a stairwell), with only 9 rooms in the floor deck. Floor 1 showed The Sentry Drone three times in one reveal. Rulebook Setup says each floor has 'its own set of cards, consisting of normal Rooms and special rooms called Stairwells', which does not say how many stairwells or whether copies are allowed. Question for the designer.

Floor 4 turn 13: Sexy Blob is Ambush and Relentless, a stairwell at Oomph 20 or Scramble 20. Ambush forces entry on reveal and Relentless puts a fled room on top of the Floor deck, so as I read the rulebook it is revealed and forced again every turn I cannot reach 20. Question for the designer: is that loop intended, and does a revealed Ambush stairwell on the very first reveal of a floor leave any way to choose another room?

Turn 15 flip: Sexy Blob and Regular Monster 4 both Ambush. Rulebook says if more than one revealed room has Ambush, choose one to enter. I chose Monster 4, whose Flee is only Exhaust 1, so Sexy Blob (not entered) goes to the bottom of the Floor deck and the Relentless loop is broken for now. Is this meant to be the way out of a Relentless Ambush stairwell? Also Panic's text adds +2 Scramble to every threshold, shown here as 'Oomph 20 and Scramble 2 (printed 0)', so a threshold with no Scramble now asks for Scramble 2.

Turn 17 Sexy Blob: I built Oomph 5 from Gray's Kung Fu and had Red ready for 14 (Cross Punch with the Scramble bonus, two Pry Bars), 19 of 20. Nothing in hand or draws gave the last point, so I fled without playing Red's cards. Every point of the Blob's threshold is a whole card, and a hand is five cards, so 20 sits at the edge of what one turn can reach with these decks.

Floor 5 opening hands each hold a System Feedback (Bad Stuff). Both Bad Stuff cards I held at the Ascend came back in the reshuffled decks, so Bad Stuff goes into the deck at Ascend and is drawn next floor. Rulebook 10 says shuffle ALL your cards into your deck, which includes them as written, but Stuff section says Stuff you gain goes into your hand. Question for the designer: should Bad Stuff return to its pool at Ascend?

Bubbly Slime Monster is Corrosive. Gray paid for Pick The Lock with I Know Kung Fu and Pick The Lock and the log line says 'Exhausting them', but Gray's Exhaust pile stayed at 9, so the cards were Scrapped as the rulebook says. The log wording does not say Scrapped. Not a rules mismatch, a log mismatch.
